verified_behaviors: Expired metadata and content are denied before cleanup, including expiry during storage reads and transaction waits.
Queued, processing, retrying and completed runs cannot restore removed content.
Cleanup removes source objects, analyses, page/model payloads, approvals, reviews and linked job/session records.
Lost deletion responses retain storage capacity until safe completion.
Unavailable report, orphan and prefix objects do not starve independent work in supported small/default/mixed batches.
Mixed failed-orphan and late-prefix cleanup releases only the safely removed source's capacity.
Existing Firestore Timestamp values and ISO strings are supported.
Concurrent uploads, analyses and approvals share bounded atomic capacity accounting.
Audit growth is capped, deletion capacity exceeds admission, and repeated API errors have sanitized bounded logs.
Administrator diagnostics contain only safe operational fields and correlation IDs.
Service-stop configuration blocks new work while preserving authorized unexpired reads.
Read-lock and commit aborts share five transaction attempts without repeating external processing.
limitations: The payload ledger excludes separately bounded metadata, indexes and infrastructure billable storage.
A hosted cleanup execution and live credit balance were not measured; deployment and owner monitoring remain necessary.
No held-out extraction quality or signed Android release gate is claimed passed.
